items.title: Tyler Allgeier: Accrues 19 touches Sunday
items.text:
Allgeier compiled 17 carries for 46 yards and caught two of three targets for no yards during Sunday's 17-3 defeat at Seattle.

items.title: Woody Marks: Logs 19 more touches in Week 9
items.text:
Marks turned 18 carries into 70 yards and hauled in just one of four targets for four yards during Sunday's 44-22 road win over the Chargers.

items.title: Drake Maye: Saddled by three picks in loss
items.text:
Maye completed 21 of 38 passes for 299 yards with three touchdowns and three interceptions while adding one rush for three yards in the Patriots' 45-27 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Career-high receiving yards in win
items.text:
Golden brought in all 10 targets for 164 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Tallies 13 touches in Week 9
items.text:
Price posted nine carries for 24 yards and secured all four targets for 54 yards during Sunday's 17-3 victory versus the Cardinals.
